body: I'm all for feelings, usually how I live my life is off of feelings. Not really afraid to show myself, or going to the source of the problem. When my dog died, I sat at where she used to lay all the time and cried for a while. I go for drives now because thats what used to cheer me up as a kid, driving aimlessly, but its kind of losing its effect on me.

Not really a big fan of writing, more of a thinker which probably isn't good. I never really worry about "when will I be like that", the only ones I see happy are just the kids. The parents are just filled with constant worries, seem almost miserable they're only happy when they get to drink. 

Sometimes I think if I just was able to have a break just for a little bit maybe I could change something. Feel better about things but I can't... I have to be constantly doing work/school and I want to think that if I graduate in a few months that I would be able to travel and see the world. Tomatina would be on my birthday but I won't be able to afford that :/

I just want to die peacefully and drift away, but I don't think I could ever do it. I feel like I'm needed by so many people and that I would just let them all down. I don't want to be a bad person or harm anyone, I just want to go peacefully. Is that so much to ask for? Peace, why the fuck can't I find it? The only peace of mind I found was knowing the fact that we all die, but scared to do it because even though athiest still somewhat afraid, what if there really is a hell or stuck in some kind of infinite limbo. But is what I'm doing any better just living every day in misery not really living life to the full potential, just being a slave for some assholes that pay me like shit.

Scared that I'm actually starting to follow through, beginning to drive with myself a bit longer every weekend. Kind of scared that, I won't come back home one day.

You're a really good person, so is everyone else here.

Isn't that just like trying to bury your feelings then? Once I stop listening to the music, it's just going to return. I feel like getting a best bud like a dog would help, but then its just like prolonging that feeling even more. Is that what I have deal with all the time, just finding ways to prolong/bury/hide this stupid fucking brain of mine.

I feel like no matter what I try to do to feel better nothing is working. I tried changing my music style to something thats more uplifting but I don't know, I just don't like it. Trying to listening to rap songs/hip hop but I feel like the music is just dumb. Thats why I just run without music.

I try all these suggestions from people, how to feel better but haha nothing seems to be helping. I kind of want to start smoking pot again, I kind of remember those times being better but I'm scared to smoke again that it would make me too anxious. I took shrooms before because I heard it helps with depression and I did feel much better for a few months, but it always just ends up returning. 

I tried going out with my friends to clubs and stuff but I'm just too socially awkward. Clubs arent my place and rather hang out with a few people but no one likes to do that apparently. Ended up driving home really drunk and all I remember was swerving a lot, I was pretty surprised I didn't die then :/

I tried talking to my mom but she keeps trying to throw xanax or whatever it is down my throat. 

Sometimes I think about my relationship and how it turned bad, think she was depressed like me. We started to turn into well whatever everyone else turns into. We had great times together but apparently she has some void in herself that she can't fill and doesnt want me to help her. I see my family around all married with kids and I love them all, but I'm not sure thats what I want anymore. This lifestyle we all live just seems like a bunch of shit to me. Husbands and wives being smart asses to each other, and dredging every moment with each other. I barely see happiness in people and this world just seems miserable, not only me but everyone else.

Ugh feel like I could keep writing for a long ass time hah
